concepts.gloss_en: 'A woman who fears the Lord' (Prov 31:30) — read as malkhut/gevirta, the aspect of counsel (etza)

members.note: same verse phrase without quotation marks — pure orthographic variant

concepts.gloss_en: 'Fear of the Lord' itself — the aspect of tefillin (per Berakhot 6). Distinct from the construct phrase 'a WOMAN who fears the Lord'; different head/referent

members.note: the abstract fear of God, equated with tefillin; not the woman-subject phrase

notes: 'אשה יראת ה' (subject = the woman/malkhut) is a different concept from bare 'יראת ה' (the fear itself = tefillin). Different construct heads / referents per rule 4 — kept separate despite token overlap.
